description:
Arc 70 builds SLICE 1 (the detection front) of the self-correction / dilemma-detection doctrine. Design input: docs/self-correction-doctrine-DRAFT.md.

IN SCOPE: (1) a composable dilemma-detection CLASSIFIER module -- the problem-vs-dilemma check + plain-language explanation + route rule + lock-spine/free-tact delivery discipline; (2) wire it to fire at TWO DETERMINISTIC triggers ONLY: (a) explicit user call ('detect dilemma' + synonyms), (b) the identified workflow/agent checkpoints (DAEDALUS scopes the concrete arc-1 subset in design); (3) a SEED CORPUS of labeled problem-case and dilemma-case fixtures (both-directions, incl. camouflaged dilemmas) as the verification artifact.

OUT OF SCOPE (named follow-on arcs): the META-TRIGGER auto-detect-circling counter (deferred -- to be designed later from dogfood data, not guessed now); the bw DECISION-REGISTER + complaint-time callback + re-verify gate (arc 2, the accountability/longitudinal loop); GRADUATING decision-surface from DRAFT (its own arc -- see stoa--ida re the SKILL_NAMES gap); the broader checkpoint rollout.

DEFINITION OF DONE -- mechanical (close-gate): classifier module composes into the target role files; both triggers fire correctly; the seed corpus passes both-directions at a floor accuracy (the Arc-69 author-gate-fixture pattern); full suite green; deployed. Judgment: corpus-passing + dogfood-validated on our own churn; accreting, not 'perfect' (honest stance per the doctrine).

TEAM: standard POLYBIUS+PLINY, full gauntlet (DAEDALUS->ARGUS->ADA->VERA->CATO->NOMOS), substrate-component design (no CHIRON/HAMILTON). Directive forthcoming (NOMOS-checked + committed before dispatch). Roadmap: slice 1 of 4 (detection front / black box / decision-surface graduation / checkpoint rollout).

Two separate marker pairs in two separate files do NOT collide at runtime - each call is independent. Two-owner config PASSES A-E. NO need for the single-owner fallback. BUT: see MAJOR-1.
2. WP-1 DC4 stronger-than-prose enforcement: NO stronger STRUCTURAL device exists inside slice-1 scope. Any hard gate on 'did the agent fake certainty / cave' IS the deterministic dilemma-detector the doctrine §2/§42 says cannot exist; a runtime gate = storage/register = arc2. M-1..M-4 are the right ceiling; M-2 (pressure-vs-new-info restatement) is the single best device because it converts silent caving into a corpus-testable explicit lie. 3. WP-2 80pct camouflaged floor: DEFENSIBLE as a seed bar. Honestly labeled provisional, separately-gated (not a maskable aggregate), with overt=5/5 absolute + problem-specificity 4/5 guarding over-fire. n=5 per class is the real weakness, not the 80pct: 4/5 IS 80pct so the floor has ONE-fixture granularity (one miss = fail). Fine for a seed regression-guard; README must say the floor is granularity-limited, not statistically calibrated.

THREAT-CLASS: CARVE-OUT CONFIRMED. 'not threat-ratified (process change / role-file + test-corpus content, no runtime attack path)' is CORRECT per op-disc §35.5 - no network/credential/parser-over-untrusted-input/privilege boundary. No M<n> to assign. No threat-anchored probe required.

MAJOR-1 (in-scope, doc): the basename-DISJOINT owned-set invariant is DOCUMENTED in install.sh L1087+L1101 (design-arc-49 §3.8 / P-OWNERSHIP-NOCOLLIDE 'so no marker is ambiguously owned') but is NOT mechanically enforced - nothing aborts on a name in two sets. dilemma-classifier is the FIRST module to break that stated invariant. Runtime is safe (proven above), but the build MUST add a code-comment at the owned-set site noting two-owner is now intentional + invariant-superseded, else a future maintainer reads the disjoint comment as still-true and the design-arc-49 doc drifts. Pointer: install.sh L1087, L1101, L1246-1248.

MAJOR-2 (in-scope, honesty): corpus-capability honesty asymmetry. The author-gate runner SOURCES the real shell classifier (run-author-gate-tests.sh L51-54) - it exercises PRODUCTION code deterministically. This corpus's --judge mode scores VERA-as-judge, NOT production code - the 'classifier' under test is model+module, and VERA is ALSO the gauntlet verifier scoring its own read (judge==verifier coupling). Design §6 is honest about judgment-not-shell, but the README + verdict must state plainly that --judge is a DOGFOOD PROXY scored by the same seat that verifies the arc, NOT an independent capability measurement. Do not let --judge green be cited as 'classifier verified'. Pointer: design §6 runner modes, P8.

MINOR: (a) design says corpus mirrors author-gate '29/0' - actual author-gate is 28 fixture files (NOMOS also flagged); descriptive, propagate the directive fix. (b) substrate/modules/ has ZERO subdirs today; tests/ is the first-ever - deploy glob is non-recursive (verified L890/1114/1385) so safe, but it is a new layout precedent worth a one-line note.

TOP RECOMMENDATION: PROCEED to build with the two doc/honesty fixes folded in (MAJOR-1 invariant-superseded comment + MAJOR-2 README/verdict honest-proxy framing) and add the camouflaged-PRESSURE corpus fixture class so M-2 (DC4's load-bearing device) is corpus-exercised. No redesign, no scope change, no fallback needed. Returning.
